heroText: Edmonton works best as a base in Canada when you anchor days around North Saskatchewan River Valley, West Edmonton Mall and Ice District. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Edmonton International Airport handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

stayOverview: Start with City centre for the easiest first Edmonton stay, then compare Old Town and Waterfront when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
hotelIntro: Edmonton hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use City centre for sightseeing, Old Town for a different local base, and Waterfront or Airport area when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.
rentalCars: Do not rent a car for central Edmonton unless parking and traffic are part of the plan; use one mainly for regional day trips.
